title: Maths and English practice rebuilt
details: Replaces the old mock-style Functional Skills screen with reliable multiple-choice practice
Maths Level 2 is split into 5 equal parts with 5 questions in each part
English Level 2 is split into 5 equal parts with 5 questions in each part
Every question has A, B and C answer choices plus D — Teach me
Wrong answers show the correct answer and explain how to reach it
Teach me shows the correct answer and explains why it is correct
The practice is self-contained so it does not wait for separate question-pack files to load
summary: Evia v194 rebuilds Functional Skills Level 2 as five-part multiple-choice learning practice for Maths and English.
changes: Removed the old Reading/Writing mock-style Functional Skills interface
Added 25 Maths Level 2 multiple-choice practice questions
Added 25 English Level 2 multiple-choice practice questions
Added D — Teach me to every question
Added teaching feedback after incorrect answers
Moved the practice into one self-contained offline asset for more reliable loading
Forced a new v194 offline shell so installed copies receive the rebuild
